from pathlib import Path
root = Path(r'C:\gw1-stage\w3\scratch-20260925-1857')

import hashlib, json
from pathlib import Path
src, dst = Path(r'C:\gw3-20260925-1857-t5a\examples\minimum-shelf-flagship\tool.seal.json'), Path(r'C:\gw1-stage\w3\scratch-20260925-1857\tamper\tool.seal.json')
data = bytearray(src.read_bytes())
digest = json.loads(data.decode('utf-8'))['subject'][0]['digest']
key, value = next(iter(digest.items()))
i = bytes(data).index(value.encode())
old = chr(data[i]); new = '0' if old != '0' else '1'
data[i] = ord(new)
dst.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True); dst.write_bytes(bytes(data))
json.loads(dst.read_bytes().decode('utf-8'))
print(f'subject digest ({key}) first hex digit at byte offset {i}: {old!r} -> {new!r}')
print('original sha256=' + hashlib.sha256(src.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
print('tampered sha256=' + hashlib.sha256(dst.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
print('bytes differing=' + str(sum(1 for x, y in zip(src.read_bytes(), dst.read_bytes()) if x != y)))
